description: Opaque dark forest-green floor-length wool overdress with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves, over a cream linen underdress. Tan-gold Celtic knotwork trim outlines the neckline, vertical front, cuffs and hem. Round gold-colored brooches decorate the shoulder straps. A narrow patterned waist belt closes with a round openwork knot clasp. A dark olive-green striped shawl rests on both forearms and hangs down the sides with knotwork borders and long fringe. Cream underdress appears through the lower front skirt opening. Brown closed leather boots are visible. No headgear, armor or weapon is present.
